text:
maria: Heads-up — canary for payments-service chart v2.3.0 started in eu-west. deploy-bot posted a postupgrade job failure (audit-hook) during the canary at ~09:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: [automated] Deployment event for payments-service:chart v2.3.0
```
Release: payments-service.eu-west
Canary: 15%
Hook job: payments-audit-hook (Job/Batch) -> FAILED
Exit: 1
Reason: Job failed: Error calling audit API: 403 PermissionDenied
Logs: https://logs.internal/payments/abcd1234
```

alex: I pulled the job logs — 403 from the external audit service. Looks like the service-account token is being rejected after yesterday's rotation. Could be subchart bump changed the SA or audience.

maria: The audit-hook was introduced in 2.3.0 (subchart dependency bump). There's a 2.3.1 patch that fixes the token audience but it needs an image rebuild and security signoff. We have two options: pin to 2.2.5 and continue rollout, or rollback the canary to remove the hook.

sre-jun: Current state: 15% canary running, no DB migrations in 2.3.0 but the chart change touched the preupgrade hooks. Change window closes in ~25m. Ops prefers pin -> hotfix path to avoid re-running any migrations or promotion race.

alex: If we pin to 2.2.5 the hook won't run, so no audit calls; behavior reverts to known-good. Rollback would also remove it but is heavier. Pin keeps release history cleaner for the promo.

ryan: Proposal: freeze promotion, apply manual pin in eu-west to 2.2.5 (deploy-bot annotation), assemble a short release-note entry: "hotfix pending — audit-hook permission regression (2.3.0)". Who can do the manual pin now?

maria: I can do it. Plan:
1) Add annotation on the release: `deploybot.pin=payments-service:2.2.5`
2) Let deploy-bot reconcile the pin and prevent promotion during the window
3) Open PR for 2.3.1 hotfix (image + token audience), attach security approval
4) If hotfix lands before window close, promote 2.3.1; otherwise keep 2.2.5 promoted and schedule follow-up.

deploy-bot: [ack] Received pin annotation for payments-service:2.2.5. Holding promotion. Canary remains at current percentages. Pin job queued: https://deploy.internal/jobs/pxy-9921

alex: Confirmed with security — the token rotation yesterday changed audience claim; audit service rejects new aud by default. Hotfix will reissue token or adjust audience. Sec expects a signed fix in ~2 hours, but not within the 25m window.

sre-jun: After pin completes, run the standard canary smoke: `curl -sS http://payments-canary.internal/health | jq .` and verify latency and error-rate are within SLOs (<200ms, error <0.5%). Also check `kubectl get jobs -n payments payments-audit-hook -o yaml` to ensure no runaway retries.

ryan: Maria — please add a one-line customer-facing blurb in the release notes draft: "Canary paused pending audit-hook permission hotfix; production not affected."

maria: Added draft release-note and PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/pull/457. Pin annotation applied. Decision rationale logged: prefer pin > rollback to avoid migration/promote complexity. I'll also update the rollout docs with the pin timestamp.

deploy-bot: [update] Pin job completed at 1760054360. Promotion remains disabled by annotation. Canary unchanged at 15%. Actions: pin recorded, ticket created: RN-457, HOTFIX-129.

alex: Thanks — looping in @support for customer-facing messaging and @security for follow-through on HOTFIX-129.

sre-jun: TL;DR: Manual pin applied to avoid audit-hook failures during change window. Hotfix tracked in HOTFIX-129. Verify smoke checks post-pin, then plan promotion once security signs off on 2.3.1.

maria: Will do final sweep and mark the rollout as "pinned — follow-up hotfix required" in the release tracker.

ryan: :thumbsup: Good call."
